simple.meaning: כָּרִי (kârîy) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a son in the family line and in connection with kingship.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in 2 Samuel, 2 Kings, beginning at 2 Samuel 20:23. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family line, covenant, kingship, land, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to כָּרִי (H3746) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows כָּרִי through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: כָּרִי (kârîy) / H3746 is tracked through 2 Samuel 20:23, 2 Kings 11:4, 2 Kings 11:19. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.

definitions.full: H3746. Kari כָּרִי adjective, of a people probably = Carian , only with article as substantive collective Carians , name given to foreign body-guard of king (compare RS OTJC 249, 2d ed.262 ) וְלָרָצִים לַכָּרִי 2Kin 11:4 compare 11:19 ; הכרי 2Sam 20:23 Kt (< Qr הַכְּרֵתִי which We Dr Bu prefer).
definitions.rootNote: perhaps an abridged plural of 3733 in the sense of leader (of the flock);
